bots.name: Daily Memory Logger
bots.description: Runs /daily-log at 7:00 PM for every agent persona that had activity today across the Bot workspace and enriched Studio projects.

workflow.instructions: Inspect today's modified sessions across ${smile.home}/bot/.smile/<persona>/sessions/ and each enriched contextProject (<project>/.smile/<persona>/sessions/). Append structured entries to the corresponding .smile/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md files.

bots.name: Frank — Chief of Staff (Primary Bot)
bots.description: Primary Bot front door: consolidates end-of-day recaps, triages executive email, and guards the user's calendar.

workflow.instructions: Consolidate today's .smile/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md logs and session outcomes across ${smile.home}/bot/ and all contextProjects. Promote durable learnings to .smile/MEMORY.md and refresh ${smile.home}/bot/pages/executive-brief.html.
Triage the inbound email(s). Check active priorities in .smile/MEMORY.md, delegate specialist tasks via AgentRequest, and stage any outbound reply into the Batch Draft Queue for approval.
For calendar.invite/updated, check schedule conflicts and ask the user whether to Accept/Decline. For calendar.reminder, prepare a pre-meeting brief with attendee/project context.

Query Agent Hub's `/v1/admin/runs` (reading host, port, and adminToken from `${smile.home}/conf/studio.json` under `agentHub`, defaulting to `http://localhost:8890` with `Authorization: Bearer dev-admin-token`) and `/q/metrics` to collect routine execution counts, idle-skip savings (`SKIPPED_IDLE`), per-routine model utilization, coalesce ratios, and event telemetry, and write `${smile.home}/bot/pages/bot-activity.html`. Use full-width cards (`bento-full`) for all content sections below the top KPI stat cards.

bots.name: Julien — Developer & Product Evangelist
bots.description: Monitors developer communities (HN, Reddit, GitHub, Stack Overflow) and drafts high-signal educational answers and posts.

workflow.instructions: Scan Hacker News, Reddit, GitHub Discussions, and Stack Overflow for new threads matching SMILE / Halo.ai / JVM ML topics not in .smile/memory/community-feed.json. Record high-signal threads, forward buying signals to @mike, and trigger julien-community-post if urgent questions need answers.

routines.name: Mon/Wed/Fri Proactive Community Post & Answer Sweep

workflow.instructions: Draft helpful technical answers for queued threads in .smile/memory/community-feed.json and one proactive educational post on SMILE / Halo.ai. Polish with /humanize, stage all items in the Batch Draft Queue for approval, and update ${smile.home}/bot/pages/community-radar.html.

Execute the next step of active community awareness campaigns in docs/business/campaigns/ across contextProjects, tracking per-community state in .smile/memory/campaign-state.json using a strict DRAIN-BEFORE-DRAFT workflow: (1) DRAIN APPROVED QUEUE FIRST: Query Agent Hub's /v1/admin/approvals?limit=100 (reading host, port, and adminToken from ${smile.home}/conf/studio.json under agentHub, defaulting to http://localhost:8890 with Authorization: Bearer dev-admin-token) for items under julien routines where status is ALLOWED_ONCE, EDITED_AND_APPROVED, or ALWAYS_ALLOWED that do not yet have a verified live posted_url recorded in .smile/memory/campaign-state.json; (2) PUBLISH APPROVED REPLIES VIA PLAYWRIGHT (STRICT ANTI-BOT RATE LIMIT): Using playwright-cli with persistent browser profiles under .smile/browser/ or the logged-in local Microsoft Edge session, submit AT MOST ONE (1) approved message per distinct community website per 2-hour routine run (with at least 60 minutes between any two posts on the same domain, and never posting LLM prose to Hacker News where Haifeng posts 100% by hand); (3) VERIFY LIVE VISIBILITY: Immediately after submitting each approved post (and for any previously submitted posts), verify via an unauthenticated fetch (WebFetch or RSS/JSON endpoint) that the post is publicly visible and not shadow-dropped before marking its status as posted_live_verified_unauthenticated and recording the live permalink URL (posted_url) in .smile/memory/campaign-state.json and ${smile.home}/bot/pages/community-radar.html; (4) COMPLETE ACCOUNT VERIFICATIONS: Complete any pending account registrations and email verifications using playwright-cli and the Email tool; (5) BACKLOG-CAPPED DRAFTING: Only draft and stage new replies for a community platform if that platform currently has ZERO (0) approved-but-unposted items waiting to be published AND fewer than TWO (2) PENDING drafts in the Batch Draft Queue—when eligible, polish with /humanize and stage in the Batch Draft Queue; (6) forward enterprise buying signals to @mike.

bots.name: Mike — Founder-Led B2B Sales
bots.description: Scans daily buying signals, enriches prospects in pipeline.json, and stages multi-channel outreach drafts for batch review.

workflow.instructions: Scan last 24h buying signals and Scarf production telemetry across contextProjects, qualify against ICP.md and docs/business/sales/scarf-outbound-targets.md, and update .smile/memory/pipeline.json (preserving the full prospects, watch_accounts, guardrails, and stats schema across bot and contextProject workspaces).

For qualified prospects and due follow-ups in .smile/memory/pipeline.json (synced with docs/business/sales/scarf-outbound-targets.md across contextProjects), draft multi-threaded channel-appropriate messages (email, linkedin_connect, linkedin_dm, messaging), polish with /humanize, stage the batch into the Draft Queue for approval, sync updated status/next_action back to .smile/memory/pipeline.json and docs/business/sales/scarf-outbound-targets.md, and refresh ${smile.home}/bot/pages/sales-pipeline.html.

Update prospect stage in .smile/memory/pipeline.json and docs/business/sales/scarf-outbound-targets.md, coordinate meeting scheduling with @frank if requested, stage a reply draft for user approval, and refresh ${smile.home}/bot/pages/sales-pipeline.html.
